title: First-Order Thermal Cooling
summary: Newton's law of cooling for a heated metallic billet immersed in an ambient convective bath using an ACSL DERIVATIVE integrator.

files.thermal_cooling.csl:
PROGRAM THERMAL_COOLING
  ! First-order lumped-capacitance convective cooling of an aluminum billet
  INITIAL
    CONSTANT tau = 12.5      ! Thermal time constant (s)
    CONSTANT tamb = 293.15   ! Ambient bath temperature (K)
    CONSTANT temp0 = 473.15  ! Initial billet temperature (K)
    CINTERVAL cint = 1.0
    MAXTERVAL maxt = 0.25
    ALGORITHM ialg = 5
  END

  DYNAMIC
    DERIVATIVE
      dtemp = -(temp - tamb) / tau
      temp = INTEG(dtemp, temp0)
      heat_loss = (temp - tamb) / tau
    END

    TERMT(t .GE. 60.0, 'Cooling transient complete')
  END

  TERMINAL
    final_delta_t = temp - tamb
  END
END

title: Damped Spring-Mass Oscillator with Energy Procedural
summary: Second-order linear mechanical oscillator with viscous damping and an ACSL PROCEDURAL block computing kinetic, potential, and total mechanical energy.

files.spring_mass.csl:
PROGRAM SPRING_MASS_OSCILLATOR
  ! Damped spring-mass oscillator with energy conservation procedural block
  INITIAL
    CONSTANT m = 2.0         ! Mass (kg)
    CONSTANT c = 0.6         ! Viscous damping coefficient (N*s/m)
    CONSTANT k = 18.0        ! Spring stiffness (N/m)
    CONSTANT x0 = 0.5        ! Initial displacement (m)
    CONSTANT v0 = 0.0        ! Initial velocity (m/s)
    CINTERVAL cint = 0.05
    MAXTERVAL maxt = 0.01
    ALGORITHM ialg = 5
  END

  DYNAMIC
    DERIVATIVE
      accel = (-k * x - c * v) / m
      v = INTEG(accel, v0)
      x = INTEG(v, x0)

      PROCEDURAL(energy = x, v)
        ke = 0.5 * m * v**2
        pe = 0.5 * k * x**2
        energy = ke + pe
      END
    END

    TERMT(t .GE. 10.0, 'Oscillator simulation complete')
  END

  TERMINAL
    final_energy = 0.5 * m * v**2 + 0.5 * k * x**2
  END
END

title: Ballistic Projectile with Aerodynamic Drag and Impact Schedule
summary: Two-dimensional nonlinear projectile trajectory with quadratic aerodynamic drag and an ACSL SCHEDULE discrete event capturing ground impact telemetry.

files.projectile.csl:
PROGRAM BALLISTIC_PROJECTILE
  ! 2D projectile trajectory with quadratic air drag and scheduled telemetry
  INITIAL
    CONSTANT g = 9.80665     ! Gravitational acceleration (m/s^2)
    CONSTANT cd = 0.47       ! Sphere drag coefficient
    CONSTANT rho = 1.225     ! Sea-level air density (kg/m^3)
    CONSTANT area = 0.015    ! Cross-sectional area (m^2)
    CONSTANT mass = 4.5      ! Projectile mass (kg)
    CONSTANT vx0 = 65.0      ! Initial horizontal velocity (m/s)
    CONSTANT vy0 = 55.0      ! Initial vertical velocity (m/s)
    CONSTANT x0 = 0.0
    CONSTANT y0 = 1.5
    LOGICAL landed = .FALSE.
    CINTERVAL cint = 0.1
    MAXTERVAL maxt = 0.02
    ALGORITHM ialg = 5
  END

  DYNAMIC
    DERIVATIVE
      speed = SQRT(vx**2 + vy**2)
      drag_k = 0.5 * rho * cd * area / mass
      ax = -drag_k * speed * vx
      ay = -g - drag_k * speed * vy
      vx = INTEG(ax, vx0)
      vy = INTEG(ay, vy0)
      x = INTEG(vx, x0)
      y = INTEG(vy, y0)
      SCHEDULE impact_ev .AT. 8.0
    END

    DISCRETE impact_ev
      landed = .TRUE.
      impact_range = x
      impact_speed = SQRT(vx**2 + vy**2)
    END

    TERMT(t .GE. 10.0, 'Trajectory integration complete')
  END

  TERMINAL
    final_range = x
  END
END

title: Chemical CSTR Exothermic Limit Cycle
summary: Coupled mass and energy balances for a non-isothermal continuous stirred-tank reactor (CSTR) with Arrhenius reaction kinetics and jacket cooling.

files.cstr_reactor.csl:
PROGRAM CSTR_LIMIT_CYCLE
  ! Non-isothermal exothermic CSTR with Arrhenius kinetics and jacket cooling
  INITIAL
    CONSTANT q_flow = 100.0   ! Volumetric flow rate (L/min)
    CONSTANT vol = 100.0      ! Reactor volume (L)
    CONSTANT caf = 1.0        ! Feed concentration of species A (mol/L)
    CONSTANT tf = 350.0       ! Feed temperature (K)
    CONSTANT tc = 300.0       ! Cooling jacket temperature (K)
    CONSTANT k0 = 7.2e10      ! Pre-exponential factor (1/min)
    CONSTANT ear = 8750.0     ! Activation energy / R (K)
    CONSTANT dh_rcp = 209.2   ! (-DeltaH) / (rho * Cp) (K*L/mol)
    CONSTANT ua_vrcp = 2.092  ! U*A / (V * rho * Cp) (1/min)
    CONSTANT ca0 = 0.5        ! Initial concentration (mol/L)
    CONSTANT temp0 = 350.0    ! Initial reactor temperature (K)
    CINTERVAL cint = 0.05
    MAXTERVAL maxt = 0.005
    ALGORITHM ialg = 5
  END

  DYNAMIC
    DERIVATIVE
      rate = k0 * EXP(-ear / temp) * ca
      dca = (q_flow / vol) * (caf - ca) - rate
      dtemp = (q_flow / vol) * (tf - temp) + dh_rcp * rate - ua_vrcp * (temp - tc)
      ca = INTEG(dca, ca0)
      temp = INTEG(dtemp, temp0)
      conversion = (caf - ca) / caf
    END

    TERMT(t .GE. 15.0, 'CSTR transient complete')
  END

  TERMINAL
    final_conversion = (caf - ca) / caf
  END
END

title: Pilot-in-the-Loop Pitch Autopilot with Aerodynamic Table
summary: Short-period longitudinal aircraft pitch autopilot with ACSL TABLE aerodynamic lookup, elevator actuator lag, discrete flight-computer sampling, and companion aerodynamic dataset.

files.autopilot.csl:
PROGRAM PITCH_AUTOPILOT
  ! Short-period longitudinal pitch autopilot with TABLE lookup and discrete FCS
  INITIAL
    CONSTANT za = -1.15       ! Normal force derivative Z_alpha (1/s)
    CONSTANT ma = -3.85       ! Pitch stiffness M_alpha (1/s^2)
    CONSTANT mq = -0.92       ! Pitch damping M_q (1/s)
    CONSTANT mde = -12.4      ! Elevator control effectiveness M_delta_e (1/s^2)
    CONSTANT tau_act = 0.05   ! Elevator hydraulic actuator time constant (s)
    CONSTANT kp = 1.8         ! Proportional pitch gain
    CONSTANT kd = 0.45        ! Pitch rate damping gain
    CONSTANT theta_cmd = 0.10 ! Commanded pitch attitude (rad)
    TABLE cm_tab, 1, 5 / -0.2, -0.1, 0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.04, 0.02, 0.0, -0.02, -0.04 /
    CINTERVAL cint = 0.02
    MAXTERVAL maxt = 0.005
    ALGORITHM ialg = 5
  END

  DYNAMIC
    DERIVATIVE
      err_theta = theta_cmd - theta
      de_cmd = kp * err_theta - kd * q_rate
      dde = (de_cmd - delta_e) / tau_act
      delta_e = INTEG(dde, 0.0)

      dalpha = za * alpha + q_rate
      dq = ma * alpha + mq * q_rate + mde * delta_e
      dtheta = q_rate

      alpha = INTEG(dalpha, 0.0)
      q_rate = INTEG(dq, 0.0)
      theta = INTEG(dtheta, 0.0)

      SCHEDULE fcs_tick .AT. 0.5
    END

    DISCRETE fcs_tick
      INTERVAL dt_fcs = 0.1
      logged_theta = theta
      logged_alpha = alpha
    END

    TERMT(t .GE. 6.0, 'Autopilot step response complete')
  END

  TERMINAL
    steady_err = theta_cmd - theta
  END
END

-- Autonomous Vehicle Health Heartbeat & Safety Fault Flags
AutonomyHealth DEFINITIONS EXPLICIT TAGS ::= BEGIN

DriveMode ::= ENUMERATED {
  manual(0),
  supervised(1),
  autonomous(2),
  minimalRiskManeuver(3),
  emergencyStop(4)
}

FaultFlags ::= BIT STRING {
  lidarDegraded(0),
  radarTimeout(1),
  gnssLost(2),
  brakeActuatorFault(3),
  steerActuatorFault(4),
  thermalDerating(5)
} (SIZE (8))

HeartbeatFrame ::= SEQUENCE {
  vehicleId     [0] IA5String (SIZE (4..16)),
  sequenceNum   [1] INTEGER (0..4294967295),
  mode          [2] DriveMode,
  faults        [3] FaultFlags,
  batteryPct    [4] INTEGER (0..100),
  note          [5] UTF8String (SIZE (1..64)) OPTIONAL
}

END

title: 10k/10k Precision Voltage Divider
summary: Code-as-hardware precision 1% resistive voltage divider with worst-case tolerance assertions, companion Resistor generic module, and ato.yaml build configuration.

files.main.ato:
from "generics/resistors.ato" import Resistor

module VoltageDivider:
    signal v_in
    signal v_out
    signal gnd

    r_top = new Resistor
    r_bot = new Resistor
    r_top.resistance = 10kohm +/- 1%
    r_bot.resistance = 10kohm +/- 1%

    v_in ~> r_top ~> v_out
    v_out ~> r_bot ~> gnd

    assert r_top.resistance within 9.8kohm to 10.2kohm
    assert r_bot.resistance within 9.8kohm to 10.2kohm

title: 3.3V LDO Linear Regulator Power Rail
summary: 5V-to-3.3V low-dropout linear voltage regulator stage with input/output bulk decoupling capacitors, feedback divider resistors, and enable pull-up.

files.ldo_3v3.ato:
from "generics/resistors.ato" import Resistor
from "generics/capacitors.ato" import Capacitor
from "generics/regulators.ato" import LDORegulator

module PowerRail3V3:
    signal v_5v
    signal v_3v3
    signal v_fb
    signal gnd

    u_ldo = new LDORegulator
    c_in = new Capacitor
    c_out = new Capacitor
    r_fb_top = new Resistor
    r_fb_bot = new Resistor

    c_in.capacitance = 10uF +/- 10%
    c_out.capacitance = 22uF +/- 10%
    r_fb_top.resistance = 31.6kohm +/- 1%
    r_fb_bot.resistance = 10kohm +/- 1%

    v_5v ~ u_ldo.v_in
    v_3v3 ~ u_ldo.v_out
    v_fb ~ u_ldo.fb
    gnd ~ u_ldo.gnd

    v_5v ~> c_in ~> gnd
    v_3v3 ~> c_out ~> gnd
    v_3v3 ~> r_fb_top ~> v_fb
    v_fb ~> r_fb_bot ~> gnd

    assert r_fb_top.resistance within 31kohm to 32.2kohm
    assert r_fb_bot.resistance within 9.8kohm to 10.2kohm

title: USB-C Powered STM32 Telemetry Carrier Board
summary: Multi-module Atopile hardware project combining a USB-C CC-pull-down front end (usb_c.ato), 3.3V power regulation stage (power.ato), shared passives library, and ato.yaml build manifest.

files.carrier.ato:
from "usb_c.ato" import UsbCInput
from "power.ato" import PowerStage3V3
from "generics/passives.ato" import Resistor, Capacitor

module TelemetryCarrierBoard:
    signal vbus_5v
    signal vcc_3v3
    signal gnd
    signal can_tx
    signal can_rx

    usb = new UsbCInput
    pwr = new PowerStage3V3
    r_term = new Resistor
    c_dec = new Capacitor

    r_term.resistance = 120ohm +/- 1%
    c_dec.capacitance = 100nF +/- 10%

    usb.vbus ~ vbus_5v
    usb.gnd ~ gnd
    pwr.v_in ~ vbus_5v
    pwr.v_out ~ vcc_3v3
    pwr.gnd ~ gnd

    vcc_3v3 ~> c_dec ~> gnd
    can_tx ~> r_term ~> can_rx

    assert r_term.resistance within 115ohm to 125ohm

title: Reversible Ligand-Receptor Binding
summary: Foundational BioNetGen rule-based model of reversible extracellular ligand binding to a monovalent cell-surface receptor with mass-action ODE network generation.

files.ligand_receptor.bngl:
begin model
begin parameters
  L0 120
  R0 200
  kp1 0.0025
  km1 0.08
end parameters

begin compartments
  EC 3 1.0
end compartments

begin molecule types
  L(r)
  R(l)
end molecule types

begin seed species
  L(r) L0
  R(l) R0
end seed species

begin observables
  Molecules FreeLigand L(r)
  Molecules FreeReceptor R(l)
  Molecules BoundComplex L(r!1).R(l!1)
end observables

begin reaction rules
  Bind: L(r) + R(l) <-> L(r!1).R(l!1) kp1, km1
end reaction rules
end model

generate_network({overwrite=>1,max_iter=>5})
simulate({method=>"ode",t_end=>20,n_steps=>200})

title: Enzymatic Phosphorylation-Dephosphorylation Cycle
summary: Goldbeter-Koshland covalent modification switch modeled with explicit kinase and phosphatase binding rules and substrate site state transitions (~U to ~P).

files.phos_cycle.bngl:
begin model
begin parameters
  S0 500
  K0 25
  P0 25
  kf_k 0.01
  kr_k 0.2
  kcat_k 0.8
  kf_p 0.01
  kr_p 0.2
  kcat_p 0.6
end parameters

begin compartments
  Cyt 3 1.0
end compartments

begin molecule types
  S(b,Y~U~P)
  K(s)
  P(s)
end molecule types

begin seed species
  S(b,Y~U) S0
  K(s) K0
  P(s) P0
end seed species

begin observables
  Molecules UnphosS S(Y~U)
  Molecules PhosS S(Y~P)
  Molecules KinaseComplex K(s!1).S(b!1)
  Molecules PhosphataseComplex P(s!1).S(b!1)
end observables

begin reaction rules

title: Stoichiometric Methane-Air Adiabatic Flame (HP)

# Stoichiometric Methane-Air Adiabatic Flame Temperature (HP Problem)
problem case=CH4_AIR_HP hp equilibrium

reactants
  fuel=CH4 wt%=100 t(k)=298.15
  oxid=O2 wt%=23.2 t(k)=298.15

output siunits short trace=1e-5
end

title: Hodgkin-Huxley 1952 Squid Giant Axon Action Potential
summary: Classic 4-state Hodgkin-Huxley neuronal excitability model with voltage-gated sodium (m, h), potassium (n), and leak ion channels encapsulated beneath the membrane component.

files.hh1952.cellml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model name="hodgkin_huxley_1952" xmlns="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/1.1#">
  <units name="millisecond">
    <unit units="second" prefix="milli"/>
  </units>
  <units name="per_millisecond">
    <unit units="second" prefix="milli" exponent="-1"/>
  </units>
  <units name="millivolt">
    <unit units="volt" prefix="milli"/>
  </units>
  <units name="microfarad_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="farad" prefix="micro"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>
  <units name="millisiemens_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="siemens" prefix="milli"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>
  <units name="microampere_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="ampere" prefix="micro"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>

  <component name="environment">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="out"/>
  </component>

  <component name="membrane">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in" private_interface="out"/>
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" initial_value="-65.0" public_interface="out" private_interface="out"/>
    <variable name="Cm" units="microfarad_per_cmsq" initial_value="1.0"/>
    <variable name="i_Stim" units="microampere_per_cmsq"/>
    <variable name="i_Na" units="microampere_per_cmsq" private_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="i_K" units="microampere_per_cmsq" private_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="i_L" units="microampere_per_cmsq" private_interface="in"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_Stim</ci>
        <piecewise>
          <piece>
            <cn>-20.0</cn>
            <apply>
              <and/>
              <apply><geq/><ci>time</ci><cn>2.0</cn></apply>
              <apply><leq/><ci>time</ci><cn>2.5</cn></apply>
            </apply>
          </piece>
          <otherwise>
            <cn>0.0</cn>
          </otherwise>
        </piecewise>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply>
          <diff/>
          <bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar>
          <ci>V</ci>
        </apply>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <apply><plus/><ci>i_Stim</ci><ci>i_Na</ci><ci>i_K</ci><ci>i_L</ci></apply>
          </apply>
          <ci>Cm</ci>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <component name="sodium_channel">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="g_Na" units="millisiemens_per_cmsq" initial_value="120.0"/>
    <variable name="E_Na" units="millivolt" initial_value="50.0"/>
    <variable name="m" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.0529"/>
    <variable name="h" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.5961"/>
    <variable name="alpha_m" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="beta_m" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="alpha_h" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="beta_h" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="i_Na" units="microampere_per_cmsq" public_interface="out"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>alpha_m</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply><times/><cn>0.1</cn><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>40.0</cn></apply></apply>
          <apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>40.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>10.0</cn></apply></apply></apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>beta_m</ci>
        <apply><times/><cn>4.0</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>65.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>18.0</cn></apply></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>alpha_h</ci>
        <apply><times/><cn>0.07</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>65.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>20.0</cn></apply></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>beta_h</ci>
        <apply><divide/><cn>1.0</cn><apply><plus/><cn>1.0</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>35.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>10.0</cn></apply></apply></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>m</ci></apply>
        <apply><minus/><apply><times/><ci>alpha_m</ci><apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><ci>m</ci></apply></apply><apply><times/><ci>beta_m</ci><ci>m</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>h</ci></apply>
        <apply><minus/><apply><times/><ci>alpha_h</ci><apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><ci>h</ci></apply></apply><apply><times/><ci>beta_h</ci><ci>h</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_Na</ci>
        <apply><times/><ci>g_Na</ci><apply><power/><ci>m</ci><cn>3</cn></apply><ci>h</ci><apply><minus/><ci>V</ci><ci>E_Na</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <component name="potassium_channel">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="g_K" units="millisiemens_per_cmsq" initial_value="36.0"/>
    <variable name="E_K" units="millivolt" initial_value="-77.0"/>
    <variable name="n" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.3177"/>
    <variable name="alpha_n" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="beta_n" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="i_K" units="microampere_per_cmsq" public_interface="out"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>alpha_n</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply><times/><cn>0.01</cn><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>55.0</cn></apply></apply>
          <apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>55.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>10.0</cn></apply></apply></apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>beta_n</ci>
        <apply><times/><cn>0.125</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>65.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>80.0</cn></apply></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>n</ci></apply>
        <apply><minus/><apply><times/><ci>alpha_n</ci><apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><ci>n</ci></apply></apply><apply><times/><ci>beta_n</ci><ci>n</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_K</ci>
        <apply><times/><ci>g_K</ci><apply><power/><ci>n</ci><cn>4</cn></apply><apply><minus/><ci>V</ci><ci>E_K</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <component name="leakage_current">
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="g_L" units="millisiemens_per_cmsq" initial_value="0.3"/>
    <variable name="E_L" units="millivolt" initial_value="-54.387"/>
    <variable name="i_L" units="microampere_per_cmsq" public_interface="out"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_L</ci>
        <apply><times/><ci>g_L</ci><apply><minus/><ci>V</ci><ci>E_L</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <group>
    <relationship_ref relationship="encapsulation"/>
    <component_ref component="membrane">
      <component_ref component="sodium_channel"/>
      <component_ref component="potassium_channel"/>
      <component_ref component="leakage_current"/>
    </component_ref>
  </group>

  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="environment" component_2="membrane"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="time" variable_2="time"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="environment" component_2="sodium_channel"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="time" variable_2="time"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="environment" component_2="potassium_channel"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="time" variable_2="time"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="membrane" component_2="sodium_channel"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="V" variable_2="V"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="i_Na" variable_2="i_Na"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="membrane" component_2="potassium_channel"/>

files.fhn.cellml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model name="fitzhugh_nagumo_cardiac" xmlns="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/1.1#">

          <piece>

              <and/>
              <apply><geq/><ci>time</ci><cn>5.0</cn></apply>
              <apply><leq/><ci>time</ci><cn>15.0</cn></apply>
            </apply>
          </piece>
          <otherwise>
            <cn>0.0</cn>
          </otherwise>
        </piecewise>

  <component name="cardiac_cell">

    <variable name="I_ext" units="per_millisecond" public_interface="in"/>

    <variable name="b" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.013"/>
    <variable name="c1" units="per_millisecond" initial_value="0.26"/>

            <apply>

      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>w</ci></apply>

          <times/>
          <ci>b</ci>

    <unit units="siemens" prefix="milli"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>
  <units name="microampere_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="ampere" prefix="micro"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>

  <component name="environment">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="out"/>
  </component>

  <component name="membrane">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" initial_value="-85.0" public_interface="out"/>
    <variable name="Cm" units="microfarad_per_cmsq" initial_value="1.0"/>
    <variable name="g_b" units="millisiemens_per_cmsq" initial_value="0.039"/>
    <variable name="E_b" units="millivolt" initial_value="-60.0"/>
    <variable name="i_b" units="microampere_per_cmsq"/>
    <variable name="i_Stim" units="microampere_per_cmsq"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_Stim</ci>
        <piecewise>
          <piece>
            <cn>-40.0</cn>
            <apply>
              <and/>
              <apply><geq/><ci>time</ci><cn>10.0</cn></apply>
              <apply><leq/><ci>time</ci><cn>11.0</cn></apply>
            </apply>
          </piece>
          <otherwise>
            <cn>0.0</cn>
          </otherwise>
        </piecewise>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_b</ci>
        <apply><times/><ci>g_b</ci><apply><minus/><ci>V</ci><ci>E_b</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>V</ci></apply>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>i_Stim</ci><ci>i_b</ci></apply></apply>
          <ci>Cm</ci>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="environment" component_2="membrane"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="time" variable_2="time"/>
  </connection>
</model>

title: Noble-1962 Purkinje Fiber with Units Library and SED-ML Pacing
summary: Multi-file Noble (1962) cardiac Purkinje fiber pacemaker model importing a reusable SI electrophysiology units library via xlink:href alongside a companion SED-ML pacing simulation protocol.

files.noble1962.cellml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model name="noble_1962_purkinje" xmlns="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/1.1#" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <import xlink:href="units_lib.cellml">
    <units name="ms_lib" units_ref="millisecond"/>
    <units name="mV_lib" units_ref="millivolt"/>
  </import>

  <units name="millisecond">
    <unit units="second" prefix="milli"/>
  </units>
  <units name="per_millisecond">
    <unit units="second" prefix="milli" exponent="-1"/>
  </units>
  <units name="millivolt">
    <unit units="volt" prefix="milli"/>
  </units>
  <units name="microfarad_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="farad" prefix="micro"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>
  <units name="millisiemens_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="siemens" prefix="milli"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>
  <units name="microampere_per_cmsq">
    <unit units="ampere" prefix="micro"/>
    <unit units="metre" prefix="centi" exponent="-2"/>
  </units>

  <component name="environment">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="out"/>
  </component>

  <component name="membrane">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in" private_interface="out"/>
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" initial_value="-87.0" public_interface="out" private_interface="out"/>
    <variable name="Cm" units="microfarad_per_cmsq" initial_value="12.0"/>
    <variable name="i_Na" units="microampere_per_cmsq" private_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="i_K" units="microampere_per_cmsq" private_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="i_Leak" units="microampere_per_cmsq" private_interface="in"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>V</ci></apply>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>i_Na</ci><ci>i_K</ci><ci>i_Leak</ci></apply></apply>
          <ci>Cm</ci>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <component name="sodium_current">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="g_Na_max" units="millisiemens_per_cmsq" initial_value="400.0"/>
    <variable name="E_Na" units="millivolt" initial_value="40.0"/>
    <variable name="m" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.01"/>
    <variable name="h" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.80"/>
    <variable name="alpha_m" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="beta_m" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="alpha_h" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="beta_h" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="i_Na" units="microampere_per_cmsq" public_interface="out"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>alpha_m</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply><times/><cn>0.1</cn><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>48.0</cn></apply></apply>
          <apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>48.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>15.0</cn></apply></apply></apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>beta_m</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply><times/><cn>0.12</cn><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>8.0</cn></apply></apply>
          <apply><minus/><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>8.0</cn></apply><cn>5.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>1.0</cn></apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>alpha_h</ci>
        <apply><times/><cn>0.17</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>90.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>20.0</cn></apply></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>beta_h</ci>
        <apply><divide/><cn>1.0</cn><apply><plus/><cn>1.0</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>42.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>10.0</cn></apply></apply></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>m</ci></apply>
        <apply><minus/><apply><times/><ci>alpha_m</ci><apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><ci>m</ci></apply></apply><apply><times/><ci>beta_m</ci><ci>m</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>h</ci></apply>
        <apply><minus/><apply><times/><ci>alpha_h</ci><apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><ci>h</ci></apply></apply><apply><times/><ci>beta_h</ci><ci>h</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_Na</ci>
        <apply><times/><ci>g_Na_max</ci><apply><power/><ci>m</ci><cn>3</cn></apply><ci>h</ci><apply><minus/><ci>V</ci><ci>E_Na</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <component name="potassium_current">
    <variable name="time" units="millisecond" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="g_K2" units="millisiemens_per_cmsq" initial_value="1.2"/>
    <variable name="E_K" units="millivolt" initial_value="-100.0"/>
    <variable name="n" units="dimensionless" initial_value="0.01"/>
    <variable name="alpha_n" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="beta_n" units="per_millisecond"/>
    <variable name="i_K" units="microampere_per_cmsq" public_interface="out"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>alpha_n</ci>
        <apply><times/><cn>0.0001</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>50.0</cn></apply><cn>10.0</cn></apply></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>beta_n</ci>
        <apply><times/><cn>0.002</cn><apply><exp/><apply><divide/><apply><minus/><apply><plus/><ci>V</ci><cn>90.0</cn></apply></apply><cn>80.0</cn></apply></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>n</ci></apply>
        <apply><minus/><apply><times/><ci>alpha_n</ci><apply><minus/><cn>1.0</cn><ci>n</ci></apply></apply><apply><times/><ci>beta_n</ci><ci>n</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_K</ci>
        <apply><times/><ci>g_K2</ci><apply><power/><ci>n</ci><cn>4</cn></apply><apply><minus/><ci>V</ci><ci>E_K</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <component name="leakage_current">
    <variable name="V" units="millivolt" public_interface="in"/>
    <variable name="g_L" units="millisiemens_per_cmsq" initial_value="0.075"/>
    <variable name="E_L" units="millivolt" initial_value="-60.0"/>
    <variable name="i_Leak" units="microampere_per_cmsq" public_interface="out"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_Leak</ci>
        <apply><times/><ci>g_L</ci><apply><minus/><ci>V</ci><ci>E_L</ci></apply></apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>

  <group>
    <relationship_ref relationship="encapsulation"/>
    <component_ref component="membrane">
      <component_ref component="sodium_current"/>
      <component_ref component="potassium_current"/>
      <component_ref component="leakage_current"/>
    </component_ref>
  </group>

  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="environment" component_2="membrane"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="time" variable_2="time"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="environment" component_2="sodium_current"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="time" variable_2="time"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="environment" component_2="potassium_current"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="time" variable_2="time"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="membrane" component_2="sodium_current"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="V" variable_2="V"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="i_Na" variable_2="i_Na"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="membrane" component_2="potassium_current"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="V" variable_2="V"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="i_K" variable_2="i_K"/>
  </connection>
  <connection>
    <map_components component_1="membrane" component_2="leakage_current"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="V" variable_2="V"/>
    <map_variables variable_1="i_Leak" variable_2="i_Leak"/>
  </connection>
</model>

title: Reversible Carbon Monoxide Oxidation Mechanism
summary: Minimal element-balanced CHEMKIN gas-phase kinetics deck for reversible CO oxidation (2 CO + O2 <=> 2 CO2) with complete NASA-7 thermodynamic polynomials and companion therm.dat.

title: Hydrogen-Oxygen Elementary Chain-Branching Mechanism
summary: Nine-species elementary H2/O2/N2 combustion mechanism featuring chain initiation, chain branching (H + O2 <=> O + OH), HO2/H2O2 radical chemistry, and complete NASA-7 thermodynamic data.

title: Methane-Air Skeletal Combustion Mechanism
summary: Four-step Jones-Lindstedt skeletal methane-air combustion mechanism covering fuel partial oxidation, steam reforming, water-gas shift, and hydrogen oxidation with full NASA-7 thermodynamics.

title: Extended Zeldovich Thermal NOx Formation Mechanism
summary: High-temperature post-flame extended Zeldovich NOx formation mechanism (N2 + O, N + O2, N + OH, NO + O2, NO2) with NASA-7 polynomials for nitrogen oxides and radical species.

title: Syngas H2/CO Elementary Kinetics with Transport Database
summary: Complete wet syngas (H2/CO/O2/N2) elementary combustion mechanism including HCO radical pathways, pressure-dependent third-body reactions, NASA-7 therm.dat, and Lennard-Jones tran.dat molecular transport database.

title: DRC-Clean Polysilicon-Metal Contact Cut
summary: Caltech Intermediate Form (CIF 2.0) MOSIS SCMOS polysilicon-to-Metal-1 contact cell satisfying all lambda minimum-width design rules (>= 3 lambda).

title: Mead-Conway NMOS Inverter Layout
summary: Classic Mead-Conway depletion-load NMOS inverter layout in CIF 2.0 featuring active diffusion, polysilicon pull-down gate, contact cuts, and Metal-1 VDD/GND power buses.

title: CMOS 2-Input NOR Standard Cell
summary: Static CMOS 2-input NOR standard cell in CIF 2.0 with N-Well PMOS series pull-up stack, parallel NMOS pull-down diffusion, dual polysilicon gates, and Metal-1 routing.

title: 2-Phase Dynamic Shift Register Stage

* IBM System/360 CSMP First-Order RC Charging Circuit
TITLE FIRST-ORDER RC CHARGING CIRCUIT
INITIAL
  PARAM R = 1000.0, C = 0.001, VIN = 5.0
  INCON VC0 = 0.0
  TAU = R * C
DYNAMIC
SORT
  VCDOT = (VIN - VC) / TAU
  VC = INTGRL(VC0, VCDOT)
  ICURR = (VIN - VC) / R
TERMINAL
  VFINAL = VC
TIMER FINTIM = 5.0, DELT = 0.01, PRDEL = 0.5, OUTDEL = 0.5
METHOD RKSFX
PRINT VC, ICURR
END
STOP

title: Damped Harmonic Oscillator
summary: Second-order linear spring-mass-damper mechanical oscillator using paired INTGRL integrators and a NOSORT energy balance calculation.

files.harmonic_oscillator.csmp:
* IBM System/360 CSMP Damped Harmonic Oscillator
TITLE DAMPED HARMONIC OSCILLATOR
INITIAL
  PARAM M = 1.5, C = 0.45, K = 12.0
  INCON X0 = 0.25, V0 = 0.0
  WN = SQRT(K / M)
DYNAMIC
SORT
  XDD = (-C * XD - K * X) / M
  XD = INTGRL(V0, XDD)
  X = INTGRL(X0, XD)
NOSORT
  ENERGY = 0.5 * M * XD**2 + 0.5 * K * X**2
TERMINAL
  FINAL_E = ENERGY
TIMER FINTIM = 10.0, DELT = 0.01, PRDEL = 0.5, OUTDEL = 0.5
METHOD RKSFX
PRINT X, XD, ENERGY
PRTPLT X(XD)
END
STOP

title: Relay-Controlled Spacecraft Attitude Thruster
summary: Single-axis rigid spacecraft attitude control using cold-gas reaction thrusters with dead-space and hysteresis switching nonlinearities.

files.spacecraft_thruster.csmp:
* Single-Axis Spacecraft Attitude Control with Deadspace Relay Thrusters
TITLE SPACECRAFT ATTITUDE THRUSTER RELAY CONTROL
INITIAL
  PARAM INERTIA = 120.0, THRUST = 1.8, KRATE = 4.0, DBAND = 0.02
  INCON THETA0 = 0.35, OMEGA0 = 0.0
DYNAMIC
SORT
  ERR = -THETA - KRATE * OMEGA
  DEAD_ERR = DEADSP(-DBAND, DBAND, ERR)
  TORQUE = THRUST * LIMIT(-1.0, 1.0, DEAD_ERR * 100.0)
  ALPHA = TORQUE / INERTIA
  OMEGA = INTGRL(OMEGA0, ALPHA)
  THETA = INTGRL(THETA0, OMEGA)
  FUEL = INTGRL(0.0, ABS(TORQUE))
TERMINAL
  TOTAL_IMPULSE = FUEL
TIMER FINTIM = 40.0, DELT = 0.05, PRDEL = 2.0, OUTDEL = 2.0
METHOD RKSFX
PRINT THETA, OMEGA, TORQUE, FUEL
END
STOP

title: Nonlinear Pendulum Phase-Plane Dynamics
summary: Large-angle nonlinear gravity pendulum with viscous pivot friction and external periodic torque forcing, illustrating phase-plane trajectories.

files.nonlinear_pendulum.csmp:
* Large-Angle Forced Nonlinear Pendulum Phase-Plane Study
TITLE NONLINEAR PENDULUM PHASE-PLANE DYNAMICS
INITIAL
  CONST GRAV = 9.80665
  PARAM LENGTH = 1.2, MASS = 2.0, DAMP = 0.15, FAMP = 1.4, WDRIVE = 2.4
  INCON PHI0 = 2.1, PHID0 = 0.0
  GL = GRAV / LENGTH
DYNAMIC
SORT
  FORCING = (FAMP / (MASS * LENGTH**2)) * SIN(WDRIVE * TIME)
  PHIDD = -GL * SIN(PHI) - (DAMP / MASS) * PHID + FORCING
  PHID = INTGRL(PHID0, PHIDD)
  PHI = INTGRL(PHI0, PHID)
NOSORT
  POT_E = MASS * GRAV * LENGTH * (1.0 - COS(PHI))
  KIN_E = 0.5 * MASS * (LENGTH * PHID)**2
  TOT_E = POT_E + KIN_E
TERMINAL
  FINAL_PHI = PHI
TIMER FINTIM = 20.0, DELT = 0.01, PRDEL = 1.0, OUTDEL = 1.0
METHOD RKSFX
PRINT PHI, PHID, TOT_E
PRTPLT PHI(PHID)
END
STOP

title: Multi-Stage Hydraulic Servomechanism with AFGEN Valve Curve
summary: Closed-loop electro-hydraulic position servomechanism combining a reusable MACRO spool-valve stage, AFGEN nonlinear orifice flow table, and PROCEDURE saturation clamping.

files.hydraulic_servo.csmp:
* Multi-Stage Electro-Hydraulic Servomechanism with Nonlinear Valve Table
TITLE HYDRAULIC SERVOMECHANISM WITH AFGEN VALVE CURVE
FUNCTION VALVEC = (-1.0, -0.85), (-0.5, -0.55), (-0.1, -0.05), (0.0, 0.0), (0.1, 0.05), (0.5, 0.55), (1.0, 0.85)
MACRO YOUT = LAGBLK(UIN, TAU, Y0)
  YOUT = INTGRL(Y0, (UIN - YOUT) / TAU)
ENDMAC
INITIAL
  PARAM KP = 4.5, TAUV = 0.04, AREA = 0.0025, MASS = 18.0, VISC = 45.0, BETA = 1.2E9, VOL = 0.001
  PARAM XREF = 0.08, QMAX = 0.0012
  INCON X0 = 0.0, V0 = 0.0, P0 = 0.0
DYNAMIC
SORT
  POSERR = XREF - XPOS
PROCEDURE UVALVE = CLAMP(POSERR, KP)
  UVALVE = LIMIT(-1.0, 1.0, KP * POSERR)
ENDPRO
  XSPOOL = LAGBLK(UVALVE, TAUV, 0.0)
  QFLOW = QMAX * AFGEN(VALVEC, XSPOOL)
  PDOT = (BETA / VOL) * (QFLOW - AREA * VEL)
  PRESS = INTGRL(P0, PDOT)
  ACCEL = (AREA * PRESS - VISC * VEL) / MASS
  VEL = INTGRL(V0, ACCEL)
  XPOS = INTGRL(X0, VEL)
TERMINAL
  FINAL_ERR = XREF - XPOS
TIMER FINTIM = 3.0, DELT = 0.002, PRDEL = 0.2, OUTDEL = 0.2
METHOD RKSFX
PRINT XPOS, VEL, PRESS, XSPOOL
END
STOP

title: Exponential Population Growth and Carrying Capacity
summary: Classic MIT DYNAMO logistic population model with crowding-dependent birth rate lookup table (TABHL) and carrying capacity feedback.

files.population_growth.dyn:
NOTE LOGISTIC POPULATION GROWTH WITH CARRYING CAPACITY
* MIT DYNAMO SYSTEM DYNAMICS MODEL
L POP.K=POP.J+(DT)*(BIRTH.JK-DEATH.JK)
N POP=1000
R BIRTH.KL=POP.K*BR.K
R DEATH.KL=POP.K*DR
A BR.K=TABHL(BRTAB,CROWD.K,0,2,0.5)
A CROWD.K=POP.K/CAP
S NETGR.K=BIRTH.JK-DEATH.JK
C DR=0.02, CAP=10000
T BRTAB=0.06/0.05/0.035/0.02/0.01
SPEC DT=0.25/LENGTH=80/PRTPER=5/PLTPER=2
PRINT POP,BIRTH,DEATH,CROWD
PLOT POP=P(0,12000)/BIRTH=B
RUN BASE

title: Inventory-Workforce Supply Chain Oscillation
summary: Forrester industrial dynamics production-inventory-workforce loop exhibiting damped inventory cycles in response to a step increase in customer orders.

files.supply_chain.dyn:
NOTE FORRESTER INVENTORY-WORKFORCE SUPPLY CHAIN OSCILLATION
L INV.K=INV.J+(DT)*(PROD.JK-SHIP.JK)
N INV=400
L WORK.K=WORK.J+(DT)*(HIRE.JK)
N WORK=20
R PROD.KL=WORK.K*PRODW
R SHIP.KL=DEMAND.K
R HIRE.KL=(DWORK.K-WORK.K)/THIRE
A DEMAND.K=BASEDEM+STEP(20,5)
A DINV.K=DEMAND.K*ICOV
A DPROD.K=DEMAND.K+(DINV.K-INV.K)/TINV
A DWORK.K=DPROD.K/PRODW
C PRODW=5, BASEDEM=100, ICOV=4, TINV=6, THIRE=8
SPEC DT=0.25/LENGTH=60/PRTPER=4/PLTPER=2
PRINT INV,WORK,PROD,SHIP
PLOT INV=I(0,800)/WORK=W(0,40)
RUN STEP_DEMAND

title: Bass New-Product Diffusion Market Adoption
summary: Two-stock Bass market diffusion model coupling advertising-driven innovation with word-of-mouth social imitation across a fixed addressable market.

files.bass_diffusion.dyn:
NOTE BASS NEW-PRODUCT DIFFUSION MARKET ADOPTION MODEL
L POT.K=POT.J+(DT)*(-ADOPT.JK)
N POT=100000
L ADOPTERS.K=ADOPTERS.J+(DT)*(ADOPT.JK)
N ADOPTERS=0
R ADOPT.KL=AD_ADOPT.K+WOM_ADOPT.K
A AD_ADOPT.K=POT.K*P_ADV
A WOM_ADOPT.K=CONTACT*FRAC_AD.K*POT.K*ADOPTERS.K/TMKT
A FRAC_AD.K=Q_WOM
A PENET.K=ADOPTERS.K/TMKT
C TMKT=100000, P_ADV=0.015, Q_WOM=0.08, CONTACT=5

title: SIR Epidemic with Behavioral Feedback Delay
summary: Compartmental Susceptible-Infectious-Recovered (SIR) epidemic model with third-order information delay (DELAY3) modulating contact rate as perceived prevalence rises.

files.sir_epidemic.dyn:
NOTE SIR EPIDEMIC MODEL WITH BEHAVIORAL PERCEPTION DELAY
L SUSC.K=SUSC.J+(DT)*(-INFECT.JK)
N SUSC=9990
L INF.K=INF.J+(DT)*(INFECT.JK-RECOV.JK)
N INF=10
L REC.K=REC.J+(DT)*(RECOV.JK)
N REC=0
R INFECT.KL=CONT_EFF.K*BETA*SUSC.K*INF.K/NTOT
R RECOV.KL=INF.K/DUR
A PREV.K=INF.K/NTOT
A PERC_PREV.K=DELAY3(PREV.K,TDEL)
A CONT_EFF.K=TABHL(CTAB,PERC_PREV.K,0,0.2,0.05)
A R_EFF.K=CONT_EFF.K*BETA*DUR*SUSC.K/NTOT
C NTOT=10000, BETA=0.08, DUR=7, TDEL=5
T CTAB=10/7.5/5.0/3.2/2.0
SPEC DT=0.25/LENGTH=120/PRTPER=10/PLTPER=4
PRINT SUSC,INF,REC,R_EFF
PLOT SUSC=S(0,10000)/INF=I(0,4000)/REC=R(0,10000)
RUN EPIDEMIC

title: World3-Inspired Resource-Capital-Pollution System Dynamics
summary: Coupled four-sector Meadows World3-style global dynamics model linking industrial capital, nonrenewable resources, persistent pollution, and population mortality feedback.

files.world3_coupled.dyn:
NOTE WORLD3-INSPIRED RESOURCE-CAPITAL-POLLUTION COUPLED SYSTEM DYNAMICS
L POP.K=POP.J+(DT)*(BIRTH.JK-DEATH.JK)
N POP=3000
L CAP.K=CAP.J+(DT)*(INVEST.JK-DEPREC.JK)
N CAP=600
L RES.K=RES.J+(DT)*(-USE.JK)
N RES=100000
L POL.K=POL.J+(DT)*(POLGEN.JK-POLABS.JK)
N POL=50
R BIRTH.KL=POP.K*BR_NORM*BMULT.K
R DEATH.KL=POP.K*DR_NORM*DMULT.K
R INVEST.KL=OUTPUT.K*INVFRAC
R DEPREC.KL=CAP.K/CAPLIFE
R USE.KL=OUTPUT.K*RESINT
R POLGEN.KL=OUTPUT.K*POLINT
R POLABS.KL=POL.K/POLTIME
A RESFRAC.K=RES.K/RES0
A RESMULT.K=TABHL(RMULT,RESFRAC.K,0,1,0.25)
A OUTPUT.K=CAP.K*CAP_PROD*RESMULT.K
A OUT_PC.K=OUTPUT.K/POP.K
A POLRATIO.K=POL.K/POL0
A BMULT.K=TABHL(BTAB,OUT_PC.K,0,1,0.25)
A DMULT.K=TABHL(DTAB,POLRATIO.K,0,10,2.5)
C BR_NORM=0.032, DR_NORM=0.014, INVFRAC=0.22, CAPLIFE=15
C CAP_PROD=0.35, RESINT=0.8, POLINT=0.04, POLTIME=10
C RES0=100000, POL0=50
T RMULT=0.05/0.35/0.70/0.92/1.00
T BTAB=1.20/1.05/0.85/0.65/0.55
T DTAB=0.90/1.05/1.35/1.85/2.60
SPEC DT=0.5/LENGTH=150/PRTPER=10/PLTPER=5
PRINT POP,CAP,RES,POL,OUTPUT
PLOT POP=P(0,12000)/CAP=C(0,4000)/POL=X(0,1000)
RUN STANDARD_RUN

title: Thermostat Hysteresis Room Heating
summary: Thermal room heating plant coupled to a reusable ESL SUBMODEL controller with deadband hysteresis switching via WHEN discontinuity events.

files.thermostat.esl:
-- ESA ESL Thermostat-Controlled Room Heating with Hysteresis Submodel
STUDY RoomHeatingStudy
  SUBMODEL HeaterPower(IN REAL: cmd; IN REAL: p_max; OUT REAL: q_heat)
  DYNAMIC
    q_heat = cmd * p_max;
  END SUBMODEL HeaterPower

  MODEL ThermalRoom
    CONSTANT REAL: C_TH = 18000.0;  -- Room thermal capacitance (J/K)
    CONSTANT REAL: G_LOSS = 45.0;   -- Wall conductance (W/K)
    CONSTANT REAL: T_AMB = 5.0;     -- Outdoor temperature (C)
    CONSTANT REAL: P_MAX = 2500.0;  -- Heater rated power (W)
    CONSTANT REAL: T_LOW = 19.5;    -- Lower hysteresis threshold (C)
    CONSTANT REAL: T_HIGH = 21.5;   -- Upper hysteresis threshold (C)
    REAL: temp, q_heat, heater_cmd;
  INITIAL
    temp = 16.0;
    heater_cmd = 1.0;
  DYNAMIC
    HeaterPower(heater_cmd, P_MAX, q_heat);
    temp' = (q_heat - G_LOSS * (temp - T_AMB)) / C_TH;
    WHEN temp >= T_HIGH THEN
      heater_cmd := 0.0;
    END_WHEN
    WHEN temp <= T_LOW THEN
      heater_cmd := 1.0;
    END_WHEN
  END MODEL ThermalRoom
END STUDY RoomHeatingStudy

summary: Digital chronometer modeled in Esterel using suspend/when for pause-resume control, parallel lap-freeze display handling, and strong abort reset preemption.

files.stopwatch.strl:
% Digital Stopwatch with Start/Stop, Lap Freeze, and Strong Reset Preemption
module Stopwatch:
input TICK, START_STOP, LAP, RESET;
output DISPLAY_TICK, LAP_FROZEN, CLEARED;
relation START_STOP # RESET;

loop
  abort
    [
      loop
        await START_STOP;
        abort
          every TICK do
            emit DISPLAY_TICK
          end
        when START_STOP;
        pause
      end
    ||
      loop
        await LAP;
        abort
          sustain LAP_FROZEN
        when LAP;
        pause
      end
    ]
  when RESET do
    emit CLEARED
  end;
  pause
end
end module

title: Elevator Door Obstruction and Timeout Controller
summary: Reactive elevator cabin door controller handling open requests, dwell timer expiration, optical light-curtain obstruction reversal via trap/exit, and motor commands.

files.elevator_door.strl:
% Elevator Door Obstruction Reversal and Timeout Reactive Controller
module ElevatorDoor:
input OPEN_REQ, DOOR_OPENED, DOOR_CLOSED, OBSTRUCT, DWELL_DONE;
output MOTOR_OPEN, MOTOR_CLOSE, CHIME;
relation DOOR_OPENED # DOOR_CLOSED;

loop
  await OPEN_REQ;
  trap CYCLE_DONE in
    loop
      abort
        sustain MOTOR_OPEN
      when DOOR_OPENED;
      emit CHIME;
      await DWELL_DONE;
      abort
        sustain MOTOR_CLOSE
      when DOOR_CLOSED or OBSTRUCT do
        present DOOR_CLOSED then
          exit CYCLE_DONE
        else
          pause
        end
      end
    end
  end;
  pause
end
end module

% Avionics Cockpit Display Mode Manager with Master Caution Alarm Submodule
module AlarmHandler:
input FAULT_IN, ACK_BTN, FAULT_CLEARED;
output MASTER_WARN, AUDIO_TONE;

loop
  await FAULT_IN;
  abort
    [
      sustain MASTER_WARN
    ||
      abort
        sustain AUDIO_TONE
      when ACK_BTN
    ]
  when FAULT_CLEARED;
  pause
end
end module

module CockpitDisplayManager:
input MODE_NAV, MODE_ENG, FAULT_ENG, MASTER_ACK, FAULT_OK, POWER_RST;
output SHOW_NAV, SHOW_ENG, WARN_LAMP, CHIME_OUT;
relation MODE_NAV # MODE_ENG;

loop
  abort
    [
      loop
        abort
          sustain SHOW_NAV
        when MODE_ENG;
        abort
          sustain SHOW_ENG
        when MODE_NAV;
        pause
      end
    ||
      run AlarmHandler [
        signal FAULT_ENG / FAULT_IN,
               MASTER_ACK / ACK_BTN,
               FAULT_OK / FAULT_CLEARED,
               WARN_LAMP / MASTER_WARN,
               CHIME_OUT / AUDIO_TONE
      ]
    ]
  when POWER_RST;
  pause
end

title: RK4 Damped Harmonic Oscillator
summary: Fourth-order Runge-Kutta (RK4) numerical integrator in Fortran 90 solving a viscously damped mechanical mass-spring-damper oscillator with energy tracking.

files.oscillator.f90:
subroutine damped_oscillator_rk4(x_in, v_in, x_out, v_out, energy)
  implicit none
  real(8) :: x_in, v_in, x_out, v_out, energy
  real(8) :: m, c, k, dt, inv_m
  real(8) :: k1x, k1v, k2x, k2v, k3x, k3v, k4x, k4v
  real(8) :: xm2, vm2, xm3, vm3, xm4, vm4

  m = 2.0d0
  c = 0.4d0
  k = 18.0d0
  dt = 0.01d0
  inv_m = 0.5d0

  k1x = v_in
  k1v = -(c * v_in + k * x_in) * inv_m

  xm2 = x_in + 0.5d0 * dt * k1x
  vm2 = v_in + 0.5d0 * dt * k1v
  k2x = vm2
  k2v = -(c * vm2 + k * xm2) * inv_m

  xm3 = x_in + 0.5d0 * dt * k2x
  vm3 = v_in + 0.5d0 * dt * k2v
  k3x = vm3
  k3v = -(c * vm3 + k * xm3) * inv_m

  xm4 = x_in + dt * k3x
  vm4 = v_in + dt * k3v
  k4x = vm4
  k4v = -(c * vm4 + k * xm4) * inv_m

  x_out = x_in + (dt * 0.1666666666666667d0) * (k1x + 2.0d0 * k2x + 2.0d0 * k3x + k4x)
  v_out = v_in + (dt * 0.1666666666666667d0) * (k1v + 2.0d0 * k2v + 2.0d0 * k3v + k4v)
  energy = 0.5d0 * m * v_out * v_out + 0.5d0 * k * x_out * x_out
end subroutine damped_oscillator_rk4

subroutine heat1d_step(t_mid)
  implicit none
  real(8) :: t_mid
  real(8) :: u(41), u_new(41)
  real(8) :: r
  integer :: i, n

  r = 0.25d0

  do i = 1, 41
    u(i) = 20.0d0
    u_new(i) = 20.0d0
  end do
  u(1) = 100.0d0
  u(41) = 20.0d0

  do n = 1, 200
    u_new(1) = 100.0d0
    u_new(41) = 20.0d0
    do i = 2, 40
      u_new(i) = u(i) + r * (u(i + 1) - 2.0d0 * u(i) + u(i - 1))
    end do
    do i = 1, 41
      u(i) = u_new(i)
    end do
  end do

  t_mid = u(21)
end subroutine heat1d_step

title: Symmetric Positive-Definite Conjugate Gradient Solver
summary: Matrix-free Krylov subspace Conjugate Gradient solver for a 1D discrete Poisson tridiagonal linear system with residual norm convergence check.

files.cg_solver.f90:
subroutine cg_tridiagonal_solve(res_norm)
  implicit none
  real(8) :: res_norm
  real(8) :: x(16), b(16), r(16), p(16), ap(16)
  real(8) :: rsold, rsnew, pap, alpha, beta, denom_pap, denom_rs
  integer :: i, iter

  do i = 1, 16
    x(i) = 0.0d0
    b(i) = 1.0d0
    r(i) = 1.0d0
    p(i) = 1.0d0
    ap(i) = 0.0d0
  end do

  rsold = 16.0d0

  do iter = 1, 30
    ap(1) = 2.0d0 * p(1) - p(2)
    do i = 2, 15
      ap(i) = -p(i - 1) + 2.0d0 * p(i) - p(i + 1)
    end do
    ap(16) = -p(15) + 2.0d0 * p(16)

    pap = 0.0d0
    do i = 1, 16
      pap = pap + p(i) * ap(i)
    end do

    denom_pap = 1.0d0
    if (pap > 1.0d-12) then
      denom_pap = pap
    end if
    alpha = rsold / denom_pap

    rsnew = 0.0d0
    do i = 1, 16
      x(i) = x(i) + alpha * p(i)
      r(i) = r(i) - alpha * ap(i)
      rsnew = rsnew + r(i) * r(i)
    end do

    denom_rs = 1.0d0
    if (rsold > 1.0d-12) then
      denom_rs = rsold
    end if
    beta = rsnew / denom_rs

    do i = 1, 16
      p(i) = r(i) + beta * p(i)
    end do
    rsold = rsnew
  end do

  res_norm = rsold
end subroutine cg_tridiagonal_solve

files.constants_mod.f90:
module constants_mod
  implicit none
  real(8), parameter :: MU_EARTH = 3.986004418d14
  real(8), parameter :: R_EARTH  = 6.378137d6
end module constants_mod
files.rk4_mod.f90:
module rk4_mod
  use constants_mod
  implicit none
contains
  subroutine two_body_rhs(y, dydt)
    real(8), intent(in)  :: y(6)
    real(8), intent(out) :: dydt(6)
    real(8) :: r, r3

    r = sqrt(y(1)*y(1) + y(2)*y(2) + y(3)*y(3))
    r3 = max(r * r * r, 1.0d-12)
    dydt(1) = y(4)
    dydt(2) = y(5)
    dydt(3) = y(6)
    dydt(4) = -MU_EARTH * y(1) / r3
    dydt(5) = -MU_EARTH * y(2) / r3
    dydt(6) = -MU_EARTH * y(3) / r3
  end subroutine two_body_rhs

  subroutine rk4_orbit_step(y, dt)
    real(8), intent(inout) :: y(6)
    real(8), intent(in)    :: dt
    real(8) :: k1(6), k2(6), k3(6), k4(6)

    call two_body_rhs(y, k1)
    call two_body_rhs(y + 0.5d0 * dt * k1, k2)
    call two_body_rhs(y + 0.5d0 * dt * k2, k3)
    call two_body_rhs(y + dt * k3, k4)
    y = y + (dt / 6.0d0) * (k1 + 2.0d0 * k2 + 2.0d0 * k3 + k4)
  end subroutine rk4_orbit_step
end module rk4_mod

title: 2D Lid-Driven Cavity Navier-Stokes Projection Solver
summary: Multi-module Fortran 90 incompressible CFD fractional-step projection solver separating Cartesian grid parameters, pressure Poisson relaxation, and wall boundary conditions.

files.cavity_main.f90:
program cavity_navier_stokes
  use grid_mod
  use poisson_mod
  use bc_mod
  implicit none

  real(8) :: u(289), v(289), p(289), rhs(289)
  real(8) :: dt, nu, inv_2dx, inv_dx2, inv_dt, u_center
  integer :: step, k

  dt = 0.002d0
  nu = 0.01d0
  inv_2dx = 8.0d0
  inv_dx2 = 256.0d0
  inv_dt = 500.0d0

  do k = 1, 289
    u(k) = 0.0d0
    v(k) = 0.0d0
    p(k) = 0.0d0
    rhs(k) = 0.0d0
  end do

  do step = 1, 20
    call apply_cavity_bc(u, v)
    do k = 19, 271
      rhs(k) = ((u(k + 1) - u(k - 1)) * inv_2dx + (v(k + 17) - v(k - 17)) * inv_2dx) * inv_dt
    end do
    call solve_pressure_poisson(p, rhs, 15)
    do k = 19, 271
      u(k) = u(k) - dt * (p(k + 1) - p(k - 1)) * inv_2dx + nu * dt * (u(k + 1) - 2.0d0 * u(k) + u(k - 1)) * inv_dx2
      v(k) = v(k) - dt * (p(k + 17) - p(k - 17)) * inv_2dx + nu * dt * (v(k + 17) - 2.0d0 * v(k) + v(k - 17)) * inv_dx2
    end do
  end do

  u_center = u(145)
end program cavity_navier_stokes
files.grid_mod.f90:
module grid_mod
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: NX = 17
  integer, parameter :: NY = 17
  real(8), parameter :: DX = 1.0d0 / dble(NX - 1)
  real(8), parameter :: DY = 1.0d0 / dble(NY - 1)
end module grid_mod
files.poisson_mod.f90:
module poisson_mod
  use grid_mod
  implicit none
contains
  subroutine solve_pressure_poisson(p, rhs, nit)
    real(8), intent(inout) :: p(NX, NY)
    real(8), intent(in)    :: rhs(NX, NY)
    integer, intent(in)    :: nit
    real(8) :: pn(NX, NY), denom
    integer :: it, i, j

    denom = 2.0d0 * (DX * DX + DY * DY)
    do it = 1, nit
      pn = p
      do j = 2, NY - 1
        do i = 2, NX - 1
          p(i, j) = ((pn(i + 1, j) + pn(i - 1, j)) * DY * DY + &
                     (pn(i, j + 1) + pn(i, j - 1)) * DX * DX - &
                     rhs(i, j) * DX * DX * DY * DY) / denom
        end do
      end do
      p(1, :) = p(2, :)
      p(NX, :) = p(NX - 1, :)
      p(:, 1) = p(:, 2)
      p(:, NY) = 0.0d0
    end do
  end subroutine solve_pressure_poisson
end module poisson_mod
files.bc_mod.f90:
module bc_mod
  use grid_mod
  implicit none
contains
  subroutine apply_cavity_bc(u, v)
    real(8), intent(inout) :: u(NX, NY), v(NX, NY)
    u(1, :) = 0.0d0
    u(NX, :) = 0.0d0
    u(:, 1) = 0.0d0
    u(:, NY) = 1.0d0
    v(1, :) = 0.0d0
    v(NX, :) = 0.0d0
    v(:, 1) = 0.0d0
    v(:, NY) = 0.0d0
  end subroutine apply_cavity_bc
end module bc_mod

title: Isothermal Batch Reactor First-Order Decay
summary: Foundational gPROMS dynamic model of an isothermal well-mixed batch reactor with first-order irreversible conversion A -> B and typed physical variables.

files.batch_reactor.gproms:
DECLARE
  TYPE
    Concentration = 1.0 : 0.0 : 100.0 UNIT = "mol/L"
    ReactionRate  = 0.0 : -1000.0 : 1000.0 UNIT = "mol/(L*s)"
  END
END

MODEL IsothermalBatchReactor
  PARAMETER
    k AS REAL DEFAULT 0.25

  VARIABLE
    C_A AS Concentration
    C_B AS Concentration
    r   AS ReactionRate

  EQUATION
    r = k * C_A ;
    $C_A = -r ;
    $C_B = r ;
END

PROCESS BatchSimulation
  UNIT
    B101 AS IsothermalBatchReactor
  SET
    B101.k := 0.25 ;
  INITIAL
    B101.C_A := 5.0 ;
    B101.C_B := 0.0 ;
  SOLUTIONPARAMETERS
    ReportingInterval := 0.1 ;
    TotalTime := 20.0 ;
END

title: Tubular Plug-Flow Reactor Axial Dispersion PDE
summary: Distributed-parameter gPROMS PDE model of a tubular plug-flow reactor with axial dispersion, first-order reaction, and Danckwerts inlet boundary condition.

files.tubular_pfr.gproms:
DECLARE
  TYPE
    Concentration = 1.0 : 0.0 : 100.0 UNIT = "mol/L"
  END
END

MODEL AxialDispersionPFR
  PARAMETER
    v    AS REAL DEFAULT 0.6
    D_ax AS REAL DEFAULT 0.015
    k    AS REAL DEFAULT 0.35
    C_in AS REAL DEFAULT 8.0

  DISTRIBUTION_DOMAIN
    Axial AS [ 0.0 : 1.0 ] N = 15

  VARIABLE
    C AS DISTRIBUTION(Axial) OF Concentration

  BOUNDARY
    C(0.0) = C_in ;

  EQUATION
    $C = -v * PARTIAL(C, Axial) + D_ax * PARTIAL(PARTIAL(C, Axial), Axial) - k * C ;
END

PROCESS TubularPfrSimulation
  UNIT
    T301 AS AxialDispersionPFR
  SET
    T301.v := 0.6 ;
    T301.D_ax := 0.015 ;
    T301.k := 0.35 ;
    T301.C_in := 8.0 ;
  INITIAL
    T301.C := 0.0 ;
  SOLUTIONPARAMETERS
    TotalTime := 8.0 ;
    TimeStep := 0.005 ;
END

title: PAL16L8 4-Input Combinational AND/OR Gate Fuse Map

title: GAL22V10 4-Bit Binary Priority Encoder
summary: 24-pin GAL22V10 (5892 fuses) JESD3 fuse map implementing a 4-input priority encoder with OLMC architecture configuration bits and 5 functional verification vectors.

title: GAL22V10 Registered Synchronous 4-Bit Binary Counter
summary: Registered-mode GAL22V10 JESD3 fuse map configuring four clocked D-flip-flop macrocells with synchronous clear and clocked test vectors (C-clock stimulus).

title: Microprocessor Bus Memory-Map & Chip-Select Glue Logic GAL22V10
summary: Complete GAL22V10 bus-interface glue logic fuse map decoding ROM, RAM, UART, GPIO chip selects plus DTACK/BERR handshake signals, user electronic signature, and 6 bus test vectors.

title: Single-Dose One-Compartment IV Bolus PK
summary: Foundational Monolix longitudinal one-compartment intravenous bolus pharmacokinetic model with linear clearance and companion plasma concentration dataset.

files.pk1.mlxtran:
; Single-dose one-compartment IV bolus model
[LONGITUDINAL]
input = {Cl, V}

PK:
compartment(cmt = 1, amount = Ac, volume = V)
iv(cmt = 1)

EQUATION:
ddt_Ac = -(Cl / V) * Ac
Cc = Ac / V

OUTPUT:
output = {Cc}

title: Oral First-Order Absorption with Lag Time
summary: One-compartment oral absorption PK model incorporating a gastrointestinal lag time (Tlag), depot compartment absorption rate ka, and linear elimination.

files.oral_tlag.mlxtran:
; One-compartment oral absorption with lag time
[LONGITUDINAL]
input = {Tlag, ka, Cl, V}

PK:
depot(target = Ad, Tlag = Tlag)
compartment(cmt = 1, amount = Ac, volume = V)

EQUATION:
ddt_Ad = -ka * Ad
ddt_Ac = ka * Ad - (Cl / V) * Ac
Cc = Ac / V

OUTPUT:
output = {Cc}

title: Two-Compartment Nonlinear Michaelis-Menten Elimination
summary: Two-compartment pharmacokinetic ODE system with saturable Michaelis-Menten metabolic clearance (Vm, Km) and reversible peripheral tissue distribution.

files.mm_pk.mlxtran:
; Two-compartment nonlinear Michaelis-Menten elimination model
[LONGITUDINAL]
input = {Vm, Km, V1, Q, V2}

PK:
compartment(cmt = 1, amount = Ac, volume = V1)
compartment(cmt = 2, amount = Ap, volume = V2)
iv(cmt = 1)

EQUATION:
Cc = Ac / V1
ddt_Ac = -(Vm * Cc) / (Km + Cc) - (Q / V1) * Ac + (Q / V2) * Ap
ddt_Ap = (Q / V1) * Ac - (Q / V2) * Ap

OUTPUT:
output = {Cc}

title: Target-Mediated Drug Disposition (TMDD) mAb Model
summary: Mechanistic monoclonal antibody TMDD ODE model capturing free drug, free receptor turnover (ksyn, kdeg), high-affinity complex binding, and internalization.

files.tmdd.mlxtran:
; Target-Mediated Drug Disposition (TMDD) monoclonal antibody model
[LONGITUDINAL]
input = {kel, kpt, ktp, kon, koff, ksyn, kdeg, kint, V}

PK:
compartment(cmt = 1, amount = Ac, volume = V)
iv(cmt = 1)

EQUATION:
C = Ac / V
ddt_Ac = -kel * Ac - kpt * Ac + ktp * At - kon * C * R * V + koff * RC * V
ddt_At = kpt * Ac - ktp * At
ddt_R  = ksyn - kdeg * R - kon * C * R + koff * RC
ddt_RC = kon * C * R - (koff + kint) * RC

OUTPUT:
output = {C}

title: Tumor Growth Inhibition (TGI) Oncology PK/PD
summary: Simeoni-style oncology PK/PD model linking drug plasma exposure to proliferating tumor cells and transit-compartment apoptotic cell death.

files.tgi_pkpd.mlxtran:
; Simeoni Tumor Growth Inhibition (TGI) Oncology PK/PD Model
[LONGITUDINAL]
input = {Cl, V, kg, kkill, ktr, Kmax}

PK:
compartment(cmt = 1, amount = Ac, volume = V)
iv(cmt = 1)

EQUATION:
Cc = Ac / V
Wtot = X1 + X2 + X3
ddt_Ac = -(Cl / V) * Ac
ddt_X1 = kg * X1 * (1.0 - Wtot / Kmax) - kkill * Cc * X1
ddt_X2 = kkill * Cc * X1 - ktr * X2
ddt_X3 = ktr * X2 - ktr * X3

OUTPUT:
output = {Cc, Wtot}

  GLOBAL minf, hinf, ninf, mtau, htau, ntau
}

PARAMETER {
  gnabar = 0.12 (S/cm2) <0, 1e9>
  gkbar = 0.036 (S/cm2) <0, 1e9>
  gl = 0.0003 (S/cm2) <0, 1e9>
  ena = 50.0 (mV)
  ek = -77.0 (mV)
  el = -54.3 (mV)
}

STATE {
  m
  h
  n
}

ASSIGNED {
  v (mV)
  gna (S/cm2)
  gk (S/cm2)
  ina (mA/cm2)
  ik (mA/cm2)
  il (mA/cm2)
}

INITIAL {
  m = 0.05
  h = 0.60
  n = 0.32
}

BREAKPOINT {
  SOLVE states METHOD cnexp
  gna = gnabar * (m^3) * h
  ina = gna * (v - ena)
  gk = gkbar * (n^4)
  ik = gk * (v - ek)
  il = gl * (v - el)
}

DERIVATIVE states {
  m' = (minf - m) / mtau
  h' = (hinf - h) / htau
  n' = (ninf - n) / ntau
}

title: Covariate-Adjusted Allometric Pediatric Clearance Model
summary: Two-compartment oral population PK model (ADVAN4 TRANS4) incorporating allometric body-weight scaling on clearance and central volume for pediatric dosing.

files.cov_pk.ctl:
$PROBLEM Allometric Weight Covariate Two-Compartment Oral PK Model
$INPUT ID TIME AMT DV CMT EVID WT
$DATA pediatric_pk.csv IGNORE=@
$SUBROUTINES ADVAN4 TRANS4
$PK
  TVCL = THETA(1) * (WT / 70.0)**0.75
  TVV2 = THETA(2) * (WT / 70.0)

  V2 = TVV2 * EXP(ETA(2))

  V3 = THETA(4)

title: Joint PK/PD Indirect-Response Biomarker Model
summary: Custom $DES nonlinear ODE system (ADVAN6) coupling oral drug absorption and plasma kinetics with an Emax-inhibited indirect-response pharmacodynamic biomarker.

files.pkpd_emax.ctl:
$PROBLEM Joint Oral PK and Indirect-Response PD Biomarker Model
$INPUT ID TIME AMT DV CMT EVID
$DATA clinical_trial.csv IGNORE=@
$SUBROUTINES ADVAN6 TOL=6
$MODEL NCOMPARTMENTS=3 COMP=(DEPOT DEFDOSE) COMP=(CENTRAL DEFOBS) COMP=(BIOMARKER)
$PK
  KA   = THETA(1) * EXP(ETA(1))
  CL   = THETA(2) * EXP(ETA(2))
  V    = THETA(3)
  KIN  = THETA(4)
  KOUT = THETA(5)
  IC50 = THETA(6)
  K    = CL / V
  S2   = V
$DES
  CONC    = A(2) / V
  INH     = CONC / (IC50 + CONC)
  DADT(1) = -KA * A(1)
  DADT(2) = KA * A(1) - K * A(2)
  DADT(3) = KIN * (1.0 - INH) - KOUT * A(3)
$ERROR
  IPRED = A(2) / V
  Y = IPRED * (1 + EPS(1))
$THETA
  (0, 1.1, 10.0)   ; KA (1/h)
  (0, 4.2, 40.0)   ; CL (L/h)
  (0, 25.0, 200.0) ; V (L)
  (0, 10.0, 100.0) ; KIN (U/h)
  (0, 0.10, 2.0)   ; KOUT (1/h)
  (0, 1.5, 50.0)   ; IC50 (mg/L)
$OMEGA
  0.06 ; IIV_KA
  0.04 ; IIV_CL
$SIGMA
  0.01 ; RUV_PROP
$ESTIMATION METHOD=1 INTERACTION MAXEVAL=9999 SIGDIGITS=3 PRINT=5 NOABORT
$DOSE
  TIME=0 AMT=200 RATE=0 CMT=1 EVID=1 II=24 ADDL=2

      </Vehicle>
    </ScenarioObject>
  </Entities>
  <Storyboard>
    <Init>
      <Actions>
        <Private entityRef="Ego">
          <PrivateAction><TeleportAction><Position><LanePosition roadId="1" laneId="-2" s="20.0"/></Position></TeleportAction></PrivateAction>
          <PrivateAction>
            <LongitudinalAction>
              <SpeedAction>
                <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0.0" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="$EgoOvertakeSpeed"/></SpeedActionTarget>
              </SpeedAction>
            </LongitudinalAction>
          </PrivateAction>
        </Private>
        <Private entityRef="TruckFollow">
          <PrivateAction><TeleportAction><Position><LanePosition roadId="1" laneId="-2" s="75.0"/></Position></TeleportAction></PrivateAction>
          <PrivateAction>
            <LongitudinalAction>
              <SpeedAction>
                <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0.0" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="$PlatoonSpeed"/></SpeedActionTarget>
              </SpeedAction>
            </LongitudinalAction>
          </PrivateAction>
        </Private>
        <Private entityRef="TruckLead">
          <PrivateAction><TeleportAction><Position><LanePosition roadId="1" laneId="-2" s="115.0"/></Position></TeleportAction></PrivateAction>
          <PrivateAction>
            <LongitudinalAction>
              <SpeedAction>
                <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0.0" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="$PlatoonSpeed"/></SpeedActionTarget>
              </SpeedAction>
            </LongitudinalAction>
          </PrivateAction>
        </Private>
      </Actions>

          </Actors>
          <Maneuver name="PassPlatoonManeuver">

                  </Condition>
                </ConditionGroup>

            </Event>

files.avr_exciter.dsl:
! Automatic Voltage Regulator (IEEE ST1A) in DIgSILENT DSL
model AVR_ST1A
  input: v_meas, v_ref, v_pss
  output: efd
  parameter: Tr = 0.015, Ka = 210.0, Ta = 0.04, Vrmin = -4.5, Vrmax = 5.5
  internal: v_filt, v_err, vr

  s:v_filt = (v_meas - v_filt) / Tr
  v_err = v_ref - v_filt + v_pss
  s:vr = (Ka * v_err - vr) / Ta
  efd = lim(vr, Vrmin, Vrmax)
end

files.droop_ctrl.f90:
! External Fortran 90 P-f and Q-V Droop Controller for BESS_Droop_Inverter
subroutine bess_droop_ctrl(p_meas, q_meas, p_ref, q_ref, mp, nq, f_nom, v_nom, f_cmd, v_cmd)
  implicit none
  double precision, intent(in)  :: p_meas, q_meas, p_ref, q_ref
  double precision, intent(in)  :: mp, nq, f_nom, v_nom
  double precision, intent(out) :: f_cmd, v_cmd

  ! Linear primary frequency and voltage droop laws
  f_cmd = f_nom - mp * (p_meas - p_ref) * f_nom
  v_cmd = v_nom - nq * (q_meas - q_ref) * v_nom

  ! Clamp frequency and voltage references to IEEE 1547 safe operating band
  if (f_cmd < 0.95d0 * f_nom) f_cmd = 0.95d0 * f_nom
  if (f_cmd > 1.05d0 * f_nom) f_cmd = 1.05d0 * f_nom
  if (v_cmd < 0.90d0 * v_nom) v_cmd = 0.90d0 * v_nom
  if (v_cmd > 1.10d0 * v_nom) v_cmd = 1.10d0 * v_nom
end subroutine bess_droop_ctrl

title: First-Order Reversible Isomerization
summary: Minimal well-mixed reversible unimolecular isomerization reaction (A <-> B) with mass-action kinetic law in a single cytosolic compartment.

files.isomerization.sbml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="ReversibleIsomerization" name="First-Order Reversible Isomerization">
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="reactor" name="Well-Mixed Reactor" size="1.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="A" name="Reactant Isomer A" compartment="reactor" initialConcentration="10.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="B" name="Product Isomer B" compartment="reactor" initialConcentration="0.0" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="kf" name="Forward Rate Constant" value="0.35" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="kr" name="Reverse Rate Constant" value="0.12" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R_isom" name="Reversible Isomerization" reversible="true">
        <listOfReactants>
          <speciesReference species="A" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts>
          <speciesReference species="B" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw>
          <formula>reactor * (kf * A - kr * B)</formula>
        </kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>

title: Michaelis-Menten Enzymatic Kinetics
summary: Two-step enzymatic catalysis (E + S <-> ES -> E + P) demonstrating enzyme-substrate complex formation, steady-state turnover, and product accumulation.

files.michaelis_menten.sbml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="MichaelisMentenKinetics" name="Michaelis-Menten Enzymatic Kinetics">
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="cytosol" name="Cytosol" size="1.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="S" name="Substrate" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="12.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="E" name="Free Enzyme" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="1.5" constant="false"/>
      <species id="ES" name="Enzyme-Substrate Complex" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="0.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="P" name="Product" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="0.0" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="k_on" name="Association Rate Constant" value="0.6" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="k_off" name="Dissociation Rate Constant" value="0.15" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="k_cat" name="Catalytic Turnover Rate" value="0.45" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R_bind" name="Substrate Binding" reversible="true">
        <listOfReactants>
          <speciesReference species="S" stoichiometry="1"/>
          <speciesReference species="E" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts>
          <speciesReference species="ES" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw>
          <formula>cytosol * (k_on * S * E - k_off * ES)</formula>
        </kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_cat" name="Catalytic Conversion" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants>
          <speciesReference species="ES" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts>
          <speciesReference species="P" stoichiometry="1"/>
          <speciesReference species="E" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw>
          <formula>cytosol * k_cat * ES</formula>
        </kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>

<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="LotkaVolterraOscillator" name="Lotka-Volterra Predator-Prey Oscillator">

      <compartment id="ecosystem" name="Ecosystem Habitat" size="1.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="Prey" name="Prey Population" compartment="ecosystem" initialConcentration="40.0" constant="false"/>

    </listOfSpecies>

      <parameter id="beta" name="Predation Encounter Rate" value="0.028" constant="true"/>

      <parameter id="gamma" name="Predator Natural Mortality Rate" value="0.80" constant="true"/>

        <listOfReactants>

        </listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts>
          <speciesReference species="Prey" stoichiometry="2"/>

        <listOfModifiers>

title: Repressilator Synthetic Genetic Oscillator
summary: Elowitz and Leibler three-gene transcriptional ring oscillator (LacI, TetR, cI) with Hill-function repression, mRNA translation, and first-order degradation.

files.repressilator.sbml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="Repressilator" name="Elowitz-Leibler Repressilator Genetic Oscillator">
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="cell" name="E. coli Cell Volume" size="1.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="mLacI" name="LacI mRNA" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="5.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="mTetR" name="TetR mRNA" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="0.2" constant="false"/>
      <species id="mcI" name="Lambda cI mRNA" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="0.2" constant="false"/>
      <species id="pLacI" name="LacI Repressor Protein" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="20.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="pTetR" name="TetR Repressor Protein" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="0.5" constant="false"/>
      <species id="pcI" name="Lambda cI Repressor Protein" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="0.5" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="alpha0" name="Basal Transcription Leak" value="0.03" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="alpha" name="Maximal Regulated Transcription" value="30.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="KM" name="Repressor Half-Maximal Affinity" value="40.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="n_hill" name="Hill Cooperativity" value="2.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="k_tl" name="Translation Rate" value="5.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="kd_m" name="mRNA Degradation Rate" value="0.35" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="kd_p" name="Protein Degradation Rate" value="0.07" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R_tx_lacI" name="LacI Transcription" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="mLacI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="pcI"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>alpha0 + alpha / (1 + pow(pcI / KM, n_hill))</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_tx_tetR" name="TetR Transcription" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="mTetR" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="pLacI"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>alpha0 + alpha / (1 + pow(pLacI / KM, n_hill))</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_tx_cI" name="cI Transcription" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="mcI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="pTetR"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>alpha0 + alpha / (1 + pow(pTetR / KM, n_hill))</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_tl_lacI" name="LacI Translation" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="pLacI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="mLacI"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>k_tl * mLacI</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_tl_tetR" name="TetR Translation" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="pTetR" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="mTetR"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>k_tl * mTetR</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_tl_cI" name="cI Translation" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="pcI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="mcI"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>k_tl * mcI</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_deg_mLacI" name="mLacI Decay" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="mLacI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd_m * mLacI</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_deg_mTetR" name="mTetR Decay" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="mTetR" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd_m * mTetR</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_deg_mcI" name="mcI Decay" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="mcI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd_m * mcI</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_deg_pLacI" name="pLacI Decay" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="pLacI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd_p * pLacI</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_deg_pTetR" name="pTetR Decay" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="pTetR" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd_p * pTetR</formula></kineticLaw>

      <reaction id="R_deg_pcI" name="pcI Decay" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="pcI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd_p * pcI</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>

title: MAPK Signaling Cascade with SED-ML Experiment
summary: Three-tier Huang-Ferrell MAPK phosphorylation cascade (MKKK -> MKK -> MAPK) with negative feedback inhibition paired with a SED-ML simulation protocol.

files.mapk.sbml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="MAPKCascade" name="Three-Tier MAPK Phosphorylation Cascade">
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="cytoplasm" name="Cytoplasm" size="1.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="MKKK" name="Inactive MAPKKK" compartment="cytoplasm" initialConcentration="90.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="MKKK_P" name="Active MAPKKK-P" compartment="cytoplasm" initialConcentration="10.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="MKK" name="Inactive MAPKK" compartment="cytoplasm" initialConcentration="280.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="MKK_PP" name="Active MAPKK-PP" compartment="cytoplasm" initialConcentration="20.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="MAPK" name="Inactive MAPK" compartment="cytoplasm" initialConcentration="280.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="MAPK_PP" name="Active MAPK-PP" compartment="cytoplasm" initialConcentration="20.0" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="V1" value="2.5" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="Ki" value="9.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K1" value="10.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="V2" value="0.25" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K2" value="8.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="k3" value="0.025" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K3" value="15.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="V4" value="0.75" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K4" value="15.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="k5" value="0.025" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K5" value="15.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="V6" value="0.5" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K6" value="15.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="J_MKKK_act" name="MAPKKK Activation with Feedback" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="MKKK" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="MKKK_P" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="MAPK_PP"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>(V1 * MKKK) / ((1 + MAPK_PP / Ki) * (K1 + MKKK))</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="J_MKKK_deact" name="MAPKKK Deactivation" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="MKKK_P" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="MKKK" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw><formula>(V2 * MKKK_P) / (K2 + MKKK_P)</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="J_MKK_act" name="MAPKK Phosphorylation" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="MKK" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="MKK_PP" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="MKKK_P"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>(k3 * MKKK_P * MKK) / (K3 + MKK)</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="J_MKK_deact" name="MAPKK Dephosphorylation" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="MKK_PP" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="MKK" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>

title: Uniform Time-Course Simulation of Enzyme Kinetics
