files.run.sedml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sedML xmlns="http://sed-ml.org/sed-ml/level1/version4" level="1" version="4">
  <listOfModels>
    <model id="model_mm" name="Michaelis-Menten Enzyme" language="urn:sedml:language:sbml" source="mm_enzyme.sbml"/>
  </listOfModels>
  <listOfSimulations>
    <uniformTimeCourse id="sim_tc" name="CVODE Time Course" initialTime="0" outputStartTime="0" outputEndTime="20" numberOfSteps="100">
      <algorithm kisaoID="KISAO:0000019" name="CVODE"/>
    </uniformTimeCourse>
  </listOfSimulations>
  <listOfTasks>
    <task id="task_mm" name="Enzyme Time Course" modelReference="model_mm" simulationReference="sim_tc"/>
  </listOfTasks>
  <listOfDataGenerators>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_time" name="Time">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="t" symbol="urn:sedml:symbol:time" taskReference="task_mm"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>t</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_S" name="Substrate">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="S" target="/sbml:sbml/sbml:model/sbml:listOfSpecies/sbml:species[@id='S']" taskReference="task_mm"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>S</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_P" name="Product">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="P" target="/sbml:sbml/sbml:model/sbml:listOfSpecies/sbml:species[@id='P']" taskReference="task_mm"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>P</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
  </listOfDataGenerators>
  <listOfOutputs>
    <plot2D id="plot_enzyme" name="Substrate and Product Dynamics">
      <listOfCurves>
        <curve id="c_S" xDataReference="dg_time" yDataReference="dg_S"/>
        <curve id="c_P" xDataReference="dg_time" yDataReference="dg_P"/>
      </listOfCurves>
    </plot2D>
  </listOfOutputs>
</sedML>

<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="MM_Enzyme" name="Michaelis-Menten Kinetics">
    <listOfCompartments><compartment id="cytosol" size="1.0" constant="true"/></listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="S" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="10.0" constant="false"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="ToggleSwitch" name="Genetic Toggle Switch">
    <listOfCompartments><compartment id="cell" size="1.0" constant="true"/></listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="u" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="5.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="v" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="0.2" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="alpha" value="10.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="n" value="2.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="kd" value="1.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R_u_syn" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="u" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="v"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>alpha / (1 + pow(v, n))</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_u_deg" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="u" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd * u</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_v_syn" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="v" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="u"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>alpha / (1 + pow(u, n))</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_v_deg" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="v" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd * v</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>

title: RepeatedTask Parameter Scan over Oscillator Rate Constant
summary: SED-ML repeatedTask protocol performing a uniform linear parameter sweep across predation rate beta in a companion Lotka-Volterra SBML oscillator.

files.scan.sedml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sedML xmlns="http://sed-ml.org/sed-ml/level1/version4" level="1" version="4">
  <listOfModels>
    <model id="model_osc" name="Lotka-Volterra Oscillator" language="urn:sedml:language:sbml" source="oscillator.sbml"/>
  </listOfModels>
  <listOfSimulations>
    <uniformTimeCourse id="sim_osc" name="CVODE Integration" initialTime="0" outputStartTime="0" outputEndTime="40" numberOfSteps="200">
      <algorithm kisaoID="KISAO:0000019" name="CVODE"/>
    </uniformTimeCourse>
  </listOfSimulations>
  <listOfTasks>
    <task id="task_base" name="Single Run" modelReference="model_osc" simulationReference="sim_osc"/>
    <repeatedTask id="task_scan" name="Beta Parameter Scan" range="range_beta" resetModel="true">
      <listOfRanges>
        <uniformRange id="range_beta" start="0.01" end="0.05" numberOfSteps="4" type="linear"/>
      </listOfRanges>
      <listOfChanges>
        <setValue modelReference="model_osc" target="/sbml:sbml/sbml:model/sbml:listOfParameters/sbml:parameter[@id='beta']/@value" range="range_beta">
          <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>range_beta</ci></math>
        </setValue>
      </listOfChanges>
      <listOfSubTasks>
        <subTask order="1" task="task_base"/>
      </listOfSubTasks>
    </repeatedTask>
  </listOfTasks>
  <listOfDataGenerators>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_time" name="Time">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="t" symbol="urn:sedml:symbol:time" taskReference="task_scan"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>t</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_prey" name="Prey Population">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="Prey" target="/sbml:sbml/sbml:model/sbml:listOfSpecies/sbml:species[@id='Prey']" taskReference="task_scan"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>Prey</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
  </listOfDataGenerators>
  <listOfOutputs>
    <plot2D id="plot_scan" name="Prey Oscillation Parameter Scan">
      <listOfCurves>
        <curve id="c_prey" xDataReference="dg_time" yDataReference="dg_prey"/>
      </listOfCurves>
    </plot2D>
  </listOfOutputs>
</sedML>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="Oscillator" name="Lotka-Volterra Oscillator">
    <listOfCompartments><compartment id="hab" size="1.0" constant="true"/></listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="Prey" compartment="hab" initialConcentration="30.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="Pred" compartment="hab" initialConcentration="8.0" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="alpha" value="0.5" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="beta" value="0.025" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="gamma" value="0.7" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R_grow" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="Prey" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="Prey" stoichiometry="2"/></listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw><formula>alpha * Prey</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_eat" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="Prey" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="Pred" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw><formula>beta * Prey * Pred</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_die" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="Pred" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>gamma * Pred</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>

title: Single-Server Queueing Process
summary: Minimal SIMSCRIPT II.5 discrete-event queueing model with an inline PREAMBLE, FIFO waiting set, single-unit server resource, and exponential interarrivals.

files.queue.sim:
'' MODEL: SingleServerQueue
PREAMBLE
  TEMPORARY ENTITIES
    EVERY CUSTOMER BELONGS TO WAIT.LINE
  PROCESSES
    INCLUDE ARRIVAL.GEN
    INCLUDE CUSTOMER
  RESOURCES
    EVERY CLERK
  DEFINE WAIT.LINE AS A FIFO SET
  ACCUMULATE AVG.BUSY AS THE MEAN OF N.X.CLERK
  ACCUMULATE AVG.QUEUE AS THE MEAN OF N.Q.CLERK
END

MAIN
  CREATE EVERY CLERK(1)
  LET U.CLERK = 1
  ACTIVATE AN ARRIVAL.GEN NOW
  START SIMULATION
END

PROCESS ARRIVAL.GEN
  ACTIVATE A CUSTOMER NOW
  ACTIVATE AN ARRIVAL.GEN IN EXPONENTIAL.F(5.0, 1) MINUTES
END

PROCESS CUSTOMER
  FILE THIS CUSTOMER IN WAIT.LINE
  REQUEST 1 CLERK
  REMOVE FIRST CUSTOMER FROM WAIT.LINE
  WORK EXPONENTIAL.F(4.0, 2) MINUTES
  RELINQUISH 1 CLERK
  DESTROY THIS CUSTOMER
END

  TEMPORARY ENTITIES
    EVERY FAILED.UNIT HAS A SEVERITY AND BELONGS TO REPAIR.QUEUE

    INCLUDE FAILED.UNIT
  RESOURCES

  ACCUMULATE BACKLOG AS THE MEAN OF N.Q.TECHNICIAN

MAIN

  ACTIVATE A FAILURE.GEN NOW
  START SIMULATION

PROCESS FAILURE.GEN

END

PROCESS FAILED.UNIT

  REQUEST 1 TECHNICIAN

title: Air Traffic Runway Arrival and Departure Scheduler
summary: Multi-file SIMSCRIPT II.5 airport runway operations model coordinating landing and takeoff aircraft queues, shared runway wake-turbulence separation, and weather visibility shifts.

files.runway.sim:
'' MODEL: AirTrafficRunwayScheduler
PREAMBLE
  TEMPORARY ENTITIES
    EVERY ARRIVAL.FLIGHT HAS A WAKE.CLASS AND BELONGS TO HOLDING.STACK
    EVERY DEPART.FLIGHT HAS A GATE.ID AND BELONGS TO TAXIWAY.QUEUE
  PROCESSES
    INCLUDE ARRIVAL.STREAM
    INCLUDE DEPART.STREAM
    INCLUDE ARRIVAL.FLIGHT
    INCLUDE DEPART.FLIGHT
  RESOURCES
    EVERY RUNWAY
    EVERY TERMINAL.GATE
  EVENT NOTICES
    INCLUDE WEATHER.UPDATE
  DEFINE HOLDING.STACK AS A FIFO SET
  DEFINE TAXIWAY.QUEUE AS A FIFO SET
  DEFINE HOLDING.DELAY AS A REAL VARIABLE
  DEFINE TAXI.DELAY AS A REAL VARIABLE
  TALLY AVG.HOLD.DELAY AS THE MEAN OF HOLDING.DELAY
  TALLY AVG.TAXI.DELAY AS THE MEAN OF TAXI.DELAY
  ACCUMULATE RUNWAY.UTIL AS THE MEAN OF N.X.RUNWAY
  ACCUMULATE GATE.OCCUPANCY AS THE MEAN OF N.X.TERMINAL.GATE
END

MAIN
  CREATE EVERY RUNWAY(1)
  CREATE EVERY TERMINAL.GATE(1)
  LET U.RUNWAY = 2
  LET U.TERMINAL.GATE = 12
  ACTIVATE AN ARRIVAL.STREAM NOW
  ACTIVATE A DEPART.STREAM NOW
  SCHEDULE A WEATHER.UPDATE IN 6.0 HOURS
  START SIMULATION
END

PROCESS ARRIVAL.STREAM
  ACTIVATE AN ARRIVAL.FLIGHT NOW
  ACTIVATE AN ARRIVAL.STREAM IN EXPONENTIAL.F(4.5, 1) MINUTES
END

PROCESS DEPART.STREAM
  ACTIVATE A DEPART.FLIGHT NOW
  ACTIVATE A DEPART.STREAM IN EXPONENTIAL.F(5.0, 2) MINUTES
END

PROCESS ARRIVAL.FLIGHT
  FILE THIS ARRIVAL.FLIGHT IN HOLDING.STACK
  REQUEST 1 RUNWAY
  REMOVE FIRST ARRIVAL.FLIGHT FROM HOLDING.STACK
  WORK UNIFORM.F(1.5, 2.5, 3) MINUTES
  RELINQUISH 1 RUNWAY
  REQUEST 1 TERMINAL.GATE
  WORK NORMAL.F(35.0, 8.0, 4) MINUTES
  RELINQUISH 1 TERMINAL.GATE
  DESTROY THIS ARRIVAL.FLIGHT
END

PROCESS DEPART.FLIGHT
  FILE THIS DEPART.FLIGHT IN TAXIWAY.QUEUE
  REQUEST 1 RUNWAY
  REMOVE FIRST DEPART.FLIGHT FROM TAXIWAY.QUEUE
  WORK UNIFORM.F(1.2, 2.0, 5) MINUTES
  RELINQUISH 1 RUNWAY
  DESTROY THIS DEPART.FLIGHT
END

EVENT WEATHER.UPDATE
  PRINT RUNWAY VISIBILITY CONDITIONS UPDATED
END

title: Multi-Echelon Logistics Supply Chain Network
summary: Multi-file SIMSCRIPT II.5 three-echelon freight distribution network coordinating factory dispatch, regional cross-dock sorting, fleet truck allocation, and periodic inventory audits.

files.network.sim:
'' MODEL: MultiEchelonSupplyChain
PREAMBLE
  TEMPORARY ENTITIES
    EVERY SHIPMENT HAS A WEIGHT AND BELONGS TO DISPATCH.QUEUE
    EVERY REPLENISH.ORDER HAS A SKU.CODE AND BELONGS TO DOCK.QUEUE
  PERMANENT ENTITIES
    EVERY DISTRIBUTION.HUB OWNS A DISPATCH.QUEUE
  PROCESSES
    INCLUDE ORDER.GENERATOR
    INCLUDE SHIPMENT
    INCLUDE REPLENISH.ORDER
  RESOURCES
    EVERY LINEHAUL.TRUCK
    EVERY CROSSDOCK.BAY
    EVERY LOCAL.VAN
  EVENT NOTICES
    INCLUDE INVENTORY.AUDIT
  DEFINE DISPATCH.QUEUE AS A FIFO SET
  DEFINE DOCK.QUEUE AS A FIFO SET
  DEFINE LEAD.TIME AS A REAL VARIABLE
  DEFINE DOCK.WAIT AS A REAL VARIABLE
  TALLY MEAN.LEAD.TIME AS THE MEAN OF LEAD.TIME
  TALLY MEAN.DOCK.WAIT AS THE MEAN OF DOCK.WAIT
  ACCUMULATE TRUCK.UTIL AS THE MEAN OF N.X.LINEHAUL.TRUCK
  ACCUMULATE BAY.UTIL AS THE MEAN OF N.X.CROSSDOCK.BAY
  ACCUMULATE VAN.UTIL AS THE MEAN OF N.X.LOCAL.VAN
END

MAIN
  CREATE EVERY LINEHAUL.TRUCK(1)
  CREATE EVERY CROSSDOCK.BAY(1)
  CREATE EVERY LOCAL.VAN(1)
  LET U.LINEHAUL.TRUCK = 6
  LET U.CROSSDOCK.BAY = 4
  LET U.LOCAL.VAN = 10
  ACTIVATE AN ORDER.GENERATOR NOW
  SCHEDULE AN INVENTORY.AUDIT IN 24.0 HOURS
  START SIMULATION
END

PROCESS ORDER.GENERATOR
  ACTIVATE A SHIPMENT NOW
  ACTIVATE A REPLENISH.ORDER IN EXPONENTIAL.F(3.0, 1) HOURS
  ACTIVATE AN ORDER.GENERATOR IN EXPONENTIAL.F(1.5, 2) HOURS
END

PROCESS SHIPMENT
  FILE THIS SHIPMENT IN DISPATCH.QUEUE
  REQUEST 1 LINEHAUL.TRUCK
  REMOVE FIRST SHIPMENT FROM DISPATCH.QUEUE
  WORK NORMAL.F(4.5, 0.8, 3) HOURS
  REQUEST 1 CROSSDOCK.BAY
  WORK UNIFORM.F(0.8, 1.5, 4) HOURS
  RELINQUISH 1 LINEHAUL.TRUCK
  REQUEST 1 LOCAL.VAN
  RELINQUISH 1 CROSSDOCK.BAY
  WORK EXPONENTIAL.F(1.2, 5) HOURS
  RELINQUISH 1 LOCAL.VAN
  DESTROY THIS SHIPMENT
END

PROCESS REPLENISH.ORDER
  FILE THIS REPLENISH.ORDER IN DOCK.QUEUE
  REQUEST 1 CROSSDOCK.BAY
  REMOVE FIRST REPLENISH.ORDER FROM DOCK.QUEUE
  WORK UNIFORM.F(0.5, 1.0, 6) HOURS
  RELINQUISH 1 CROSSDOCK.BAY
  DESTROY THIS REPLENISH.ORDER
END

EVENT INVENTORY.AUDIT
  PRINT DAILY MULTI-ECHELON INVENTORY AUDIT COMPLETE
END

* 48V-to-12V 100 kHz Buck DC-DC Switching Converter
.include lib/power_mosfet.lib
.include lib/pwm_ctrl.sub

Vin vin 0 DC 48
Vpwm gate_drv 0 PULSE(0 12 0 20n 20n 2.5u 10u)
Rg gate_drv gate 10

M1 vin gate sw sw NMOS_PWR
D1 0 sw D_SCHOTTKY
L1 sw vout 47u
Rl_esr vout vout_c 0.05
Cout vout_c 0 220u
Rload vout_c 0 2.4

.MODEL NMOS_PWR NMOS(LEVEL=1 VTO=3.0 KP=12.0 RD=0.04 RS=0.02 CBD=400p CBS=400p)
